headline: Janashakthi PLC posts Rs662mn Sept quarter net loss amid market volatility
summary: Janashakthi PLC posted a net loss of Rs662 million for the September quarter. Earnings were weighed down by supply-side shocks, according to the report.
why: Janashakthi is a Sri Lankan listed financial services group, so its quarterly results indicate the health of the local financial sector. Investors use them to gauge earnings and risk at Colombo-listed companies.
